crs_modern: WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for GCP coordinates; fit in EPSG:2154. Map grid = Lambert Sud (NTF Paris, EPSG:27563), km labels X 844-851, Y 111-121

stats.affine_note: affine 6-param in Lambert-93 (EPSG:2154); fit points are Lambert Sud grid intersections located at full resolution (fitted line positions, ~1-3 px), control points are monuments read by eye on full-res crops (+/-5-10 px). poly2 on same fit points: control median 12.5 m max 45.4 m (not better).

control_points_note: role=fit points define the model reported in fit_residual_m; role=control are held out of that fit and give control_error_m; the overlay/final model uses fit+control
